items.name: Story books
items.longDescription: James really enjoys story books. Please buy books that he would enjoy being read, or that you would enjoy reading to him. They don't need to be educational - fun is absolutely fine! Picture books, silly stories, adventure tales - all welcome.

items.name: Small buoyancy aid for swimming
items.longDescription: It's entirely possible that James use this for a while, but he'd like it so he can one day go near water and on boats.

items.name: Oranges
items.longDescription: James loves clementines and satsumas and can get into them by himself. He would love gifts of orange!

items.name: The Great British Colouring Book
items.shortDescription: A special colouring book created by top British cartoonists
items.longDescription: Created by over 50 cartoonists including Terry Gilliam and Quentin Blake, this book features more than 100 original cartoons showing different aspects of British culture. While it might be for when he's a bit older, it's a meaningful gift with a great story behind it - originally created for children arriving in the UK.

items.name: Cheap, robust remote control car
items.shortDescription: Want to make me smile on Christmas day?
items.longDescription: Not just when I open the present but for the rest of the day too! Find a cheap remote control car (second hand is absolutely fine) and make sure it has batteries or is charged and you're good to go. Simple fun for everyone.

notes.checkFirst: Feel free to check with Tim and Jen if you have questions.
